notes.title: Unbeatable Tank fix
notes.content:
I apologize to all players.

I got bugreports that the Tank is not working, but I did not investigate it immediately.

After inspecting it I found a very simple bug, or rather an unfinished fix that has left the Tank behaviour at an undesired state.

Now the Tank behaviour has been fixed, and optimized a little bit.

As a positive side, I also found another Tank-related bug that I fixed at the same time.

The Tank level is still hard, but at least you can now force the Tank to retreat as its supposed to go.

You can post screenshots of your Main Menu score to show how amazing you are at the game.

Happy Panzer-hunting!

- Jonne
